englisch.title: Plugins
englisch.infoDescription: Configure official plugins and install or manage other plugins here. View the built-in plugin list and runtime status in Settings → Built-in plugins.
englisch.error: Could not read all plugins, possibly due to a network problem
englisch.unavailable: This deployment runs without a manageable profile, so plugins cannot be installed or switched here.
englisch.chooseAddMethod: Choose how to add a plugin
englisch.installExistingDescription: Supports npm packages, Git repositories, and local directories
englisch.restartNotice: The change takes effect at the next start
englisch.overriddenNotice: {name} was saved, but a higher-priority configuration overrides it, so it is not in effect
englisch.partsEmpty: This plugin pack contains no components.
englisch.installDescription: Enter the plugin's package name, GitHub repository address, or local directory path.
englisch.installGuideIdTitle: Enter the plugin's npm package name
englisch.installGuideIdHint: The plugin package name is the npm package name (like dsh-xxx or @author/plugin): the part after dsh plugin add or pnpm add in a community plugin's README install command.
englisch.installGitTemplateHint: Replace this with the actual Git repository address.
englisch.installPathTemplateHint: Replace this with the actual path to your local plugin directory.
englisch.installGuideSafety: Install only plugins you trust: they run with your permissions and can damage DeepSeek Harness or leak your data.
englisch.installUpgradeNotice: On-demand Official plugins offer Update when their version differs from DSH. To update other plugins, uninstall and reinstall them.
englisch.registryLegend: The npm registry the plugin is downloaded from
englisch.registryCustomHint: Enter an internal or private npm registry address starting with http:// or https://. If it requires a login, store the credentials in ~/.npmrc on this machine.
englisch.registryCustomInvalid: Enter an address starting with http:// or https://
englisch.installProblemInvalid: This is not a package name or address that can be installed: {reason}
englisch.installProblemInstalled: This plugin is already installed. To upgrade it, uninstall it and install it again
englisch.installProblemShipped: This plugin ships with DSH; upgrading DSH updates it
englisch.installProblemNotPackage: The path does not exist or is not a valid plugin package
englisch.installProblemNotBundle: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be installed as a plugin: {reason}
englisch.installProblemNetwork: The plugin registry could not be reached; check the network and try again
englisch.installProblemNetworkAll: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}); check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry
englisch.installProblemUnknown: The plugin could not be looked up: {reason}
englisch.installFailedTitle: The plugin could not be installed
englisch.installCancelAndEdit: Cancel installation and return to editing
englisch.installApplyingCancellationError: Cancellation was not confirmed. Installation is being applied; wait for its result. {reason}
englisch.installUnknownDescription: The Host has no active installation with this request id. Check the plugin list before trying again.
englisch.installResultUnconfirmed: The installation result was not received. Check installation status. {reason}
englisch.installAwaitingAcceptance: Waiting for the Host to accept installation. Cancellation will retry automatically after confirmation.
englisch.installBackgroundUnknown: Installation result unavailable. Check the plugin list.
englisch.installBackgroundUnconfirmed: Installation status is unconfirmed. View the installation for details.
englisch.installBackgroundApplying: Installation is being applied and cannot be cancelled. View installation progress.
englisch.installCancelled: Installation cancelled; the plugin is not enabled, and downloaded files may remain
englisch.installCancelUnconfirmed: Installation has not been confirmed stopped. Retry cancellation or wait for the installation result. {reason}
englisch.installAttempt: {previous} could not serve the package; retrying through {registry} (registry {index} of {total})
englisch.installFailureNetworkAll: No registry could be reached (tried: {registries}). Check the network or proxy settings, or change the registry and retry.
englisch.installFailureNetworkHost: {host} could not be reached. A GitHub address or a .tgz link is not fetched through the registry: this machine must reach it directly or through a proxy. If the plugin is also published to npm, enter its package name instead.
englisch.installFailureDiskFull: The disk is full; the install stopped
englisch.installFailurePermission: No write permission; the plugin cannot be installed
englisch.installFailureBuildBlocked: A dependency's install scripts need your permission before the install can continue
englisch.installFailureBuildBlockedManual: pnpm blocked install scripts; allow them under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml and retry
englisch.installFailureIntegrity: The downloaded package failed its integrity check
englisch.installFailurePnpmMissing: pnpm was not found, so nothing can be installed
englisch.installFailureGeneric: Something went wrong during the install; the details say what
englisch.installDoneNothing: Install finished with no new dependency.
englisch.installDoneRestart: Installed; it loads at the next start.
englisch.installDoneOtherVersion: Under pnpm's supply-chain security policy (minimumReleaseAge), versions published more recently than the required age are not installed automatically, so this installation used {installed} instead of the latest version {version}. A newly published version has not completed this waiting period and may contain undetected malicious code or defects. If you need {version}, uninstall the current version and then install {exact} to request that version.
englisch.installApprovalDescription: These packages have install scripts that pnpm did not run.
englisch.installApprovalConsequence: Once allowed, the scripts run here with your permissions, and the permission is saved in this profile.
englisch.confirmUninstallDescription: What it provides goes away once it is uninstalled.
englisch.reasonManagementRequired: Plugin management needs it; it cannot be switched off or uninstalled.
englisch.reasonUnaddressable: The profile patch cannot address this one uniquely.
englisch.reasonInvalidSpec: Enter a valid package name or address.
englisch.reasonAmbiguousInstall: Which package was installed cannot be told from the dependency change.
englisch.reasonNotBundle: This package declares no bundle, so it cannot be managed as a plugin.
englisch.reasonNotRemovable: This package is not owned by the profile, or plugin management needs it.
englisch.reasonStopProfile: This profile runs without HMR; stop it and uninstall the package with dsh plugin.
englisch.reasonBundleInUse: Other configuration still uses this bundle's components; switch them off first.
englisch.reasonStaleApproval: The pending script approvals changed; install again to refresh them.
englisch.reasonIncompatibleVersion: {plugin} is incompatible with DSH {runtime} (requires {peers}); running it may cause crashes or data loss.
englisch.reasonIncompatibleVersionUnnamed: This plugin is incompatible with the running DSH version; running it may cause crashes or data loss.
englisch.reasonIncompatibleInstall: Install a plugin version compatible with this DSH.
englisch.reasonIncompatibleInstalled: Uninstall it and install a version compatible with this DSH.
